#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static const long long mod = 998244353;
static long long fact[400001], revFact[400001];

static void preFact(int n) {
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % mod;
    }
    revFact[n] = pow_mod(fact[n], mod - 2);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        revFact[i] = (revFact[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % mod;
    }
}

static long long pow_mod(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long result = 1;
    long long cur = base % mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * cur) % mod;
        cur = (cur * cur) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

static long long cmb(int a, int b) {
    if (a < b || a < 0 || b < 0) return 0;
    return (fact[a] * ((revFact[b] * revFact[a - b]) % mod)) % mod;
}

void solve() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n; cin >> n;
    long long tmp; cin >> tmp;
    if (n <= tmp) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return;
    }
    int k = (int)tmp;
    preFact(400000);
    long long ans = 0;
    int si = 1;
    long long t = cmb(n, n - k);
    for (int i = n - k; i >= 1; i--) {
        long long val = ((long long)si * cmb(n - k, i)) % mod;
        val = (val * pow_mod(i, n)) % mod;
        ans = (ans + val) % mod;
        si = -si;
    }
    ans = (ans * t) % mod;
    if (k != 0) ans = (ans * 2) % mod;
    cout << ans << "\n";
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
